body.message:
Unfortunately, we are unable to guarantee or confirm a rate for a one-year period, as we operate short-term rental accommodations only.

However, you are welcome to stay with us for as long as you wish. We can currently confirm the rate for September at AED 7,500. Should you wish to continue your stay beyond that period, we will review the prevailing market conditions at that time and confirm the applicable rate accordingly.

We appreciate your understanding and look forward to assisting you further.
